name: io.github.ddzyx/qiuxiaoce
title: QiuXiaoCe Football Big Data & Match Intelligence
description: Official MCP server providing real-time football standings, keyless daily fixtures, club/league search, xG match packs, lineups, and tactical statistics.

QIUXIAOCE_API_KEY.description: Optional API Key for high-frequency or deep match pack analysis. Free tier features require no key.

tools.name: get_public_today_fixtures
tools.description: Get today's public tactical match schedule (no key required).

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Get real-time football standings for European and global leagues (no key required).

tools.name: search_teams
tools.description: Search football teams by Chinese/English name and get standardized team ID (no key required).

tools.name: search_leagues
tools.description: Search football leagues and tournaments by name (no key required).

tools.name: get_topscorers
tools.description: Get league top scorers leaderboard (no key required).

tools.name: get_topassists
tools.description: Get league top assists leaderboard (no key required).

tools.name: get_team_form
tools.description: Get recent team form and attacking/defensive averages.

tools.name: get_h2h
tools.description: Get head-to-head historical results between two clubs.

tools.name: get_match_pack
tools.description: Get comprehensive pre-match tactical intelligence pack including xG, rankings, and injuries.

tools.name: get_fixture_stats
tools.description: Get full-time team statistics including shots, corners, possession, and xG.

tools.name: get_fixture_lineups
tools.description: Get starting lineups, formations, and substitutes for a match.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Search players by Chinese or English name.

tools.name: get_today_digest
tools.description: Get today's featured match digest and overview.
